name: apple-connector
description: Scoped local Apple data access for agents

scripts.start: npm run build && node dist/src/cli/index.js start --open
scripts.build: npm run build:web && tsc -p tsconfig.json && npm run build:native && rm -rf dist/web && cp -R web/dist dist/web
scripts.build:native: swift build -c release --package-path native && mkdir -p dist/native && cp native/.build/release/apple-connector-helper dist/native/apple-connector-helper
scripts.probe: npm run build && node dist/src/cli/index.js doctor --probe
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run check:jxa
